text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho doesn't feel well, so I take
her to
the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You worry too much! What are you, my
dad? Ah
well. I'll take a break if it'll
make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Familiar! Next up is summoning
class! ♪ Let's
get moving!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uh, Familiar? Why aren't you answering?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the heck's going on?! Why are
there so
many of you?!

text_block_list.name: Familiar? A
text_block_list.text:
You're such a good girl, working so hard
today!
I'm going to prepare an amazing
treat for you!

text_block_list.name: Familiar? A
text_block_list.text:
You're such a good girl, working so hard
today!
I'm going to prepare an amazing
treat for you!

text_block_list.name: Familiar? B
text_block_list.text:
Don't be fooled, Sweep! Getting babied
doesn't
help your training!

text_block_list.name: Familiar? B
text_block_list.text:
Don't be fooled, Sweep! Getting babied
doesn't
help your training!

text_block_list.name: Familiars?
text_block_list.text:
Training is more important than magic
lessons!
I sense inspiration on the
horizon today!
Wow! Sweep! Amazing!
Genius!

text_block_list.name: Familiars?
text_block_list.text:
Training is more important than magic
lessons!
I sense inspiration on the
horizon today!
Wow! Sweep! Amazing!
Genius!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Will you all shut up?! Where's my real
familiar?!

text_block_list.name: Familiar? A
text_block_list.text: I'm the real one! Now, about that treat—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I said shut up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You think I'm gonna believe any of you
are my
familiar?! Don't be stupid! I can
tell the difference
between my familiar
and clowns like you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First of all, you! What part of you is
supposed to
feel real?! My familiar isn't
all clingy and doesn't
try to butter me
up!

text_block_list.name: Familiar? A
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You, you, and you are all fake too! My
familiar
doesn't force me to do what
they say! My familiar
doesn't look down
on my magic! And my familiar
doesn't
talk like that!

text_block_list.name: Familiars?
text_block_list.text:
You noticed!
Damn!
Witch! Magic! Wow!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yawn... Well, look who it is! The real deal!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You're a pain even in my dreams,
you
know that? Useless!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho wakes up looking strangely
proud
of herself. I guess she's feeling
better!

text_block_list.name: Familiars?
text_block_list.text:
That's Sweep for you!
Forget about that!
Let's hurry up and train!
Amazing,
Sweep! Genius!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on a sec! Stop pushing me!
You're gonna
crush me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! If you're gonna show up in my
dreams, then
you better do it right! Or
you better believe
you're gonna hear
about it otherwise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho runs into my office looking

incredibly upset. I guess she didn't get
much rest
because of her dreams.
